name: Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA - Low-Cost Spay/Neuter Clinic
description: Low-cost spay/neuter surgery; county vouchers accepted for San Mateo County residents
fullDescription: Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA's clinic at its Coyote Point shelter in San Mateo provides low-cost spay and neuter surgery for members of the public, with San Mateo County residents given priority booking.
whatTheyOffer:
- Low-cost spay/neuter surgery for dogs, cats, and rabbits
- Appointments from the 1st-15th of each month reserved for San Mateo County residents
- San Mateo County residents who need more help can ask the County of San Mateo for a Spay/Neuter Assistance Voucher
- Vaccines available at check-in for an extra cost if your pet lacks proof
- Dogs and cats must be at least 4 months old; no flat-faced (brachycephalic) breeds
howToGetIt:
1. Book online (appointments open one month ahead at midnight and fill quickly)
2. Pay the $25 non-refundable deposit when booking (applied to your fees)
3. Bring proof of residency, vaccine records (DHPP/FVRCP and rabies), and any county voucher
4. Drop off at 12 Airport Blvd, San Mateo (dogs 7:00-7:30 am; cats and rabbits 7:30-8:00 am)
5. Questions? Call the spay/neuter line at 650-340-7015
keywords: Peninsula Humane Society, PHS SPCA, spay, neuter, San Mateo County, low-cost, spay neuter voucher, cat, dog, rabbit, Coyote Point
